ionicsentry.def: A throwable Arc turret, charged by Arc and Kinetic kills, that blinds on landing and periodically chains lightning to nearby targets. It replaces your grenade while ready and counts as a grenade ability.
ionicsentry.q: charge up an Arc turret that periodically chains lightning between nearby targets

knockout.def: A short buff from breaking a shield or damaging a low-health target that boosts melee damage and lunge range and makes basic melees count as Arc-powered melees.
knockout.q: Breaking a combatant or player shield, or dealing damage to a target below 30% HP, grants 'Knockout' for 6 seconds.

combinationblow.def: Stacking buff from melee kills with the Combination Blow melee that increases melee damage (up to three stacks).
combinationblow.q: grants a stack of Combination Blow for 20 seconds, up to 3 stacks.

lethalcurrent.def: A buff from casting your class ability with the Lethal Current aspect: your next melee hit lunges farther, jolts and triggers a damaging aftershock.
lethalcurrent.q: Casting your Class Ability grants 'Lethal Current' for 10 seconds, which is consumed on your next melee hit.

frontalshield.def: A forward-facing overshield from Juggernaut, raised while sprinting with full class ability energy; it absorbs incoming damage and drains your class energy when it breaks.
frontalshield.q: you gain a frontal shield that blocks incoming damage

arcability.def: Damage and kills from your Arc abilities (grenade, melee, super and Arc ability objects). Some Arc aspects and fragments pay off on Arc ability kills.
arcability.q: Defeating targets with Arc abilities or defeating jolted or blinded targets creates an Ionic Trace.

sprinting.def: Sprinting, often for a short minimum time. Several abilities and fragments activate only while or after sprinting.
sprinting.q: After sprinting for a short time, your class ability regeneration is increased.

sliding.def: Sliding along the ground. Some abilities replace your melee or pick up effects while sliding.
sliding.q: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward

reloadspeed.def: A buff that increases your weapons' reload speed (sometimes with stability or handling).
reloadspeed.q: Melee hits increase your equipped weapon's reload speed and stability for a short duration.

meleedamage.def: A temporary increase to your outgoing melee damage.
meleedamage.q: Taking melee damage briefly increases your outgoing melee damage.

healthstat.def: A temporary bonus to the Health stat (faster shield and health recovery).
healthstat.q: While sprinting, you have greatly increased health stat.

ammobrick.def: Special or Heavy ammo pickups dropped in the world. Some effects trigger when you collect them.
ammobrick.q: Sliding over ammo bricks reloads your equipped weapon
